quick: a complexing agent that improves solubility (for example piroxicam-beta-cyclodextrin)
summary: Beta-cyclodextrin is a cyclic oligosaccharide that forms inclusion complexes to improve drug solubility and onset.
indications: Used as a complexing agent that improves solubility (for example piroxicam-beta-cyclodextrin) in combination products; it has no therapeutic indication of its own

dosage.d: No therapeutic dose; present as a complexing agent that improves solubility (for example piroxicam-beta-cyclodextrin)
dosage.n: The dose is that of the product's active ingredients

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Formulation role only; no therapeutic action at the amounts used.
preg: No specific concern at excipient concentrations
lact: No specific concern at excipient concentrations
renal: Parenteral cyclodextrins accumulate in renal impairment; oral amounts are not a concern
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
